title: Listening Drill — Campus clinic route
description: Directions dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Campus clinic route
sections.transcript:
VISITOR: I'm trying to get to the campus clinic. My map shows two possible routes. Which one would you recommend?

ASSISTANT: Start at the north gate. From there, walk towards the bike shelter. Stay on the same side until you can see the sign for the clinic corridor.

VISITOR: Can I go through the middle? It looks a lot shorter on the map.

ASSISTANT: I'd avoid the central lawn today. The ground is soft after the rain. If you're meeting a group, wait by the sign so they can spot you.
